notes.title: V1.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there, players!

Thank you so much for your support and valuable feedback. We're working hard to improve the game and address your concerns. Here's what's new in the V1.1.2 update:

[b]New Features[/b]
- Added shortcut keys. WASD and ↑↓←→ can be used to move the screen.
- Added an "Exit Game" button in the settings interface.
- Display chat barrage in the Easter egg gameplay.
- Added in-game acquisition judgment after purchasing DLC.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Optimized the occasional situation where a blank area is clicked by other players, but the information is not synchronized and displayed.
- Adjusted the color of the text for flag-drawing consumption points in the German skin panel.

As a small indie team, we're constantly striving to enhance your gaming experience and address issues promptly. Your feedback is crucial to us, but please bear with us as we might not be able to respond to every issue immediately due to limited resources. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

We're also planning future updates, and we'd love to hear your ideas! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Q4nzsCN7Qt]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts. If you encounter any problems while playing, please join our community to communicate with us. This helps us understand and resolve issues more quickly.

Thanks again for your support and understanding!
Happy gaming!

notes.title: 💣"Let's Minesweeper" is Officially Released Today!💣
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032094/35c1f2f5bcb3737c6e5a422a63e8ccc55665aaf0.png[/img]

Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that "Let's Minesweeper" is now officially available on Steam! 🎉

After relentless effort and continuous optimization, we are excited to present a brand-new Minesweeper game. With 10,000,000 mines and a gigantic 48 million-square board, global multiplayer gameplay, individual flag settings, and various interface styles, everything you need is in "Let's Minesweeper"!

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all our players who have supported us along the way. Your support and feedback have inspired us to improve and provide a better gaming experience. Moving forward, we will continue to listen to your voices, bringing more updates and optimizations to make the game even more exciting.

Play "Let's Minesweeper" now with players from around the world and challenge the limits of Minesweeping!

Thank you once again for your support and love!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: 1,000 Multiplayers Sweeper with New Next Fest Demo Online!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are glad to say that Let's Minesweeper is going to show up in the Steam Next Fest! We push out a Demo to invite you into our multiplayer game with up to 1000 players on the same map.

Unlike most Mine Sweeper games, there are up to 10 million mines in every game waiting for you all to challenge! The game inherited the gameplay of traditional Minesweeper. The number in the center represents the mines in the nearby 8 tiles. You need to calculate the position of mines, mark it with a flag, and sweep out the whole area step by step.

Who is the real Master Sweeper? Let's check it out in the mine field! In addition, there is secret Easter Eggs in the game waiting for you to discover as well!

Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist, which really means a lot to us. Thank you so much for your support! We also invite you to join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/Q4nzsCN7Qt]Discord,[/url]Hope you enjoy our Minesweeper with your friends!
